newsitem.title: FRANCE: French union calls for early answer on F. Telecom.
newsitem.headline: French union calls for early answer on F. Telecom.

text.p: France's Force Ouvriere trade union called on Monday for an early decision from the government on its plans for France Telecom, which the outgoing centre-right government had planned for partial sale this month.
Officials of the Socialist party, which shared power with the combined left in a parliamentary election on Sunday, were unavailable for comment on plans for the telecommunications company.
France Telecom also said it had no comment.

The telecommunications division of the Force Ouvriere union issued a statement saying it opposed privatisations in principle and wanted the future government to clarify its position quickly on a sale of a stake in France Telecom.
Force Ouvriere is the fourth ranking union in France Telecom in terms of membership.

Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin pledged during the election campaign said he would "consult" France Telecom staff on the partial stake sale which the centre-right had initially planned to launch in May, but which had then been put back to June because of the election.
